# The first app-name/profile configure migration was fully backed out

Entry 2046 moves Thunderbird MOZ_APP_NAME and MOZ_APP_PROFILE assignments from confvars.sh to moz.configure imply_option calls. The mixed commit also migrates Suite options, but the retained lesson is scoped to the two Thunderbird files. Entry 2047 restores both Thunderbird file blobs exactly to the parent of 2046. Its subject reports build bustages without naming a reproduced failing configure step. Frozen code again places app naming in moz.configure and uses platform/enterprise conditions for profile names; the later reland belongs to entry 2059’s separate study. Preserve the backout and current exceptions when describing configuration ownership. Static source and test inspection only. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending-single-browser-reader.

Scope: Thunderbird configure migration backout chain.
